Initial clusters appear in urban centers. Early cases are misclassified as acute encephalitis, drug-induced psychosis, or severe psychiatric breaks. Emergency rooms and psychiatric wards become early amplification centers as medical staff are attacked and infected before transmission vectors are understood.
